title: One library-wide embedding model, with OpenAI small and large
description:
Embeddings from different models live in different vector spaces, so one search cannot mix them. Multi-paper chats (ARA-088) need every paper indexed with the same model. User decisions on 2026-10-09:
- one library-wide embedding model, removing the per-paper choice in Details > Advanced;
- offer OpenAI text-embedding-3-small alongside -large, and say clearly that switching re-embeds the whole library.
Today the catalog has only openai-3-large (3072 dimensions, $0.13 per million tokens) plus local Qwen3 profiles that ARA-090 gates behind the open-models flag. papers.retrieval_profile holds per-paper overrides. Embeddings are stored as dimensionless HALFVEC with document-scoped exact scans, so adding a 1536-dimensional profile needs no ANN index change.
acceptance_criteria: Given Settings, when the user views retrieval, then one library-wide embedding choice offers OpenAI text-embedding-3-small and text-embedding-3-large (large is the default), each with its price.

Given the user picks a different embedding model, when they confirm, then a dialog states that the whole library is re-embedded in the background, with the number of papers and an estimated cost, before anything changes.

Given a confirmed switch, when re-embedding runs, then every paper's ready document is indexed with the new model, questions keep working during the transition, and old-model vectors are removed once a paper's new index is ready.

Given a paper, when Details > Advanced renders, then there is no per-paper embedding choice; the per-paper override is removed end to end (API, UI and database column) rather than kept for compatibility.
Given papers that had a per-paper override, when the migration runs, then they follow the library model and are re-indexed if it differs.
Given ARA-090's flag is on, when Settings renders, then local embedding profiles may still appear as library-wide choices; nothing per-paper returns.
test_cases: Backend: catalog includes small; library switch reconciles every paper; old vectors pruned after ready; retrieval during transition.
Migration: drop papers.retrieval_profile with overrides folded into the library setting; upgrade test from the current head.
Frontend: settings choice with price, confirmation dialog with paper count and cost, no per-paper selector in Details.
verification: 2026-10-09. Red first: 13 failed, 54 passed in the focused retrieval files (KeyError 'openai-3-small', PUT /papers/{id}/retrieval still 200, estimate route 404). Full backend suite in ara-embed-test: 1005 passed in 190 s. Frontend: 5 tests red first, then npm run check passed (72 files, 532 tests) and npm run build succeeded. Migration 0008 upgrade test from 0007 passes. Not run: Playwright, live OpenAI calls. The $0.02 price and 8191-token limit come from third-party sources, not OpenAI's own page.
